title: A magazine on the park bench
situation: You are {{Connor}}. {{Hank}} has walked ahead to the riverside bench. A magazine lies on the red bench by the path.

media.title: Century: The Mysterious Mister {{Kamski}}
facts: {{Kamski}} founded {{CyberLife}} in 2018 in a cheap part of the city, broke through with blue blood and biocomponents, was named Man of the Century in 2028, then left the company after clashing with shareholders and now lives in a waterside villa exclusively with androids.

media.title: {{Detroit}} Today: Markets Predict War
facts: Stock markets are pricing in an Arctic war; military stocks are booming and investors favour {{CyberLife}} for its defence contracts.

adaptationNote: Optional reading or viewing. Contents are summarized from the in-game magazine articles and broadcasts. Watching certain news reports about android incidents lowers public opinion, as in the game.

title: What are you?
situation: You are {{Connor}}. After the club, {{Hank}} sits on a bench by the river at night, drinking, and asks you things no one has asked you: whether you are afraid to die, whether you have ever thought about what it is like, why you let those two go if you are just a machine. He pulls out his gun and points it at your head, saying he wants to know what happens when he pulls the trigger. How you answer him will decide what he thinks you are.

options.text: Answer him honestly, admitting doubt and something like fear.
Insist that you are a machine, that you feel nothing, and that his questions are irrelevant.

adaptationNote: {{Hank}} shoots {{Connor}} only if his relationship is Hostile at this point, regardless of the answer.
